title: Browns owner Jimmy Haslam says 'we're all excited' about Deshaun Watson: He 'has a great chance'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Browns owner Jimmy Haslam says 'we're all excited' about Deshaun Watson: He 'has a great chance'
sources.description: Watson's play declined in Cleveland following a wave of allegations of sexual misconduct and sexual assault. He has since sustained two Achilles tendon tears.
